description: An exact, all-order VC-shattering classification of four-query supports in the inclusive radius-one Johnson J(n,3) neighborhood family, including its orbit-count polynomial and dimension threshold.
integrity: The independent mathematical arguments and the attached standard-library executable together provide the finite-type proof. The recorded execution output is not a substitute for replaying the executable or examining its exhaustive coverage.
scientific_limitations: The orbit-classification proof uses a standalone exhaustive certificate of all 66 four-triple isomorphism types, coupled with a proof that the traces stabilize on 15 symbols. It does not determine online dimension, higher-rank Johnson classes, or complete lower-stratum polynomials. Comprehensive historical-priority checks and independent verification remain outstanding.
title: Closed Johnson-three balls have one four-point shattered orbit
